intent: gator update --migrate-layout: auto-refresh vendor hooks on convergence
notes: **Closed the v1→v2 vendor-hook-drift footgun.** `main()`'s `--migrate-layout` branch previously exited immediately after `migrate_layout()` returned, before `install_vendor_hooks()` (which runs in the normal update path). Consequence: on a v1 repo, `gator update --migrate-layout` moved shipped scripts from `.gator/scripts/` to `.gator/.includes/scripts/` but left `.claude/settings.json` / `.codex/hooks.json` / `.gemini/settings.json` pointing at the old `.gator/scripts/…` paths. Session hooks became dead targets until the user ran a follow-up `gator update`. Migration's own end-of-run message hinted at this ("Next step: run 'gator update' to refresh scripts …") but users routinely miss it — and the invariant should be structural, not procedural.

**Fix**: added `install_vendor_hooks(templates_dir, repo_root)` call in `main()`'s migration branch, gated on `report.get("final_layout") == "v2"` (successful convergence only), wrapped in `try/except` so any vendor-hook failure prints a warning to stderr but never masks or overrides the migration's own exit code. Combined with B2 (templates now ship v2 script paths), any v1 repo running `--migrate-layout` post-fix ends up with vendor hooks pointing at the correct v2 scripts in a single command.

**Sync-obligation**: applied identically to `src/gator_command/scripts/gator-update.py` (wheel) and `src/gator_command/templates/gator-starter/scripts/gator-update.py` (fleet mirror). `git diff --no-index --stat` shows the same 159-line pre-existing entry-point-inlining divergence and no new drift.

**Migration end-of-run message left alone**. "Next step: run 'gator update' to refresh scripts in .includes/" is still accurate — the recommendation refers to script content refresh, which `--migrate-layout` still doesn't do; A4 only closes the vendor-hook gap.

**Tests**: existing `TestMigration` (8 cases including A1's two new pins) all pass. No new test added — A4's behavior would need a subprocess-invocation fixture to exercise the `main()` migration branch end-to-end; deferring to a follow-on if flakiness surfaces in the field.

**Charter update**: `scripts-repo-lifecycle.md::main()` — added `--migrate-layout` to the arg list, added a TRIPWIRE explaining the vendor-hook-refresh-on-convergence contract and the exit-code preservation invariant.

Part of the "update and begin-session bugs" fix set (plan: `.gator/vault/artifacts/2026-08-03-update-and-begin-session-bugs-implementation-plan.md`, step A4 of B1→B2→A1→A4→A2→B3→A3). B2 fixed the templates so hooks POINT at v2 paths; A4 makes sure they get REWRITTEN to v2 paths automatically when a v1 repo migrates.
